Define teams and access needs</b><br>Use <a href="https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVEOGaQYU=/?moveToWidget=3458764691419502937">10D</a> to agree teams and leadership duties.<br>Map tasks, products and environments.<br>Inventory standing and overlapping grants.<br>Define baseline and elevation eligibility." fill="#a0c4fb" data-text-color="#14315e" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" stroke="#6a8bbf" />

    <rect id="m3458764690641387392" data-miro-id="3458764690641387392" x="1656" y="1200" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• Agree app development, DevOps, QA and leadership duties.<br>• Which product/environment scopes and baseline roles?<br>• Who owns groups, mappings, eligibility and approvals?<br>• Which target mechanisms, duration and emergency rules?<br>• Who verifies removal and maintains the access catalog?" fill="#ffe86d" data-text-color="#574900" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" stroke="#cbb333" />
  </g>
